description: Implementation of Category Data Access Object (DAO) for database operations related to categories in an e-commerce system, including retrieval by name, URL, code, IDs, lineage, depth, parent, store, and counting products per category.

classes.name: CategoryDaoImpl
classes.description: DAO implementation class for Category entity, providing various methods to query categories based on different criteria.

methods.name: getByName
methods.description: Retrieves a list of categories matching a name pattern within a specific store and language.

methods.name: listBySeUrl
methods.description: Lists categories filtered by SEO URL within a store.

methods.name: getBySeUrl
methods.description: Retrieves a category by its SEO URL within a store.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Retrieves a category by its code within a store.

methods.name: getByCodes
methods.description: Retrieves categories matching a list of codes within a store and language.

methods.name: getByIds
methods.description: Retrieves categories by a list of IDs within a store and language.

methods.name: getByLanguage
methods.description: Retrieves a category by ID and language.

methods.name: getByCode (overloaded)
methods.description: Retrieves a category by store code and category code.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Retrieves a category by its ID.

methods.name: listByLineage
methods.description: Lists categories by lineage within a store or store code.

methods.name: listByDepth
methods.description: Lists categories at a specific depth within a store, optionally filtered by language.

methods.name: listByParent
methods.description: Lists child categories of a given parent category within a store, filtered by language.

methods.name: listByStoreAndParent
methods.description: Lists categories within a store filtered by parent category.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Lists all categories within a store.

methods.name: countProductsByCategories
methods.description: Counts products associated with given categories within a store.

methods.name: listByStore (with language)
methods.description: Lists categories within a store filtered by language.
